# David Carlton Adams

> Composer, performer, and educator based in Baltimore. DMA in Composition,
> Peabody Institute / Johns Hopkins University. Music spanning contemporary
> chamber music, opera, improvisation, rock, and live electronics, with a
> core interest in microtonality and just intonation. Also builds and
> operates a multi-agent AI operations system (see Systems).

## Main pages

- [About](https://davidcarltonadams.com/): bio, recent performances, press, CV (PDF)
- [Works](https://davidcarltonadams.com/works.html): filterable catalogue of 50 compositions, 2008–present
- [Media](https://davidcarltonadams.com/media.html): recordings and video
- [Teaching](https://davidcarltonadams.com/teaching.html): courses, private lessons, teaching philosophy
- [Systems](https://davidcarltonadams.com/systems.html): the non-music side — a multi-agent AI operations system he built and runs daily, three interactive demos, design principles, program record, résumés (PDF)
- [Trust boundaries](https://davidcarltonadams.com/trust.html): how the system keeps untrusted input from steering it; one diagram, three worked cases (risk, control, evidence), and how the controls carry over to mission work
- [Contact](https://davidcarltonadams.com/contact.html): email and profiles
- [Eggs](https://davidcarltonadams.com/eggs.html): forty browser-based
  musical instruments and toys: just intonation lattices, rhythm machines,
  psychoacoustic illusions, tuning explorers. All run client-side in the
  browser with no accounts, and the site collects no data; the performance
  clock's shared sessions use a public PeerJS relay.
- [Nest](https://davidcarltonadams.com/nest.html): a concept map of the eggs —
  an 8-dimensional similarity embedding flattened to 2D.

## Notes

- The site is fully static (GitHub Pages); every instrument is self-contained
  HTML/JS using the Web Audio API.
- Scores and performance materials: contact via the address on the contact page.
